To: Sophia <sophiamorrowbiz@gmail.com>, Dante Newcombe-Kenealy <
dante.newcombe19@gmail.com>, Louie Zong <everydaylouie@gmail.com>, Adrian
Riachta <adrianbangun59@gmail.com>, Kaipo Lee <kaipojlee@gmail.com>, Marcus
Torres <marjazzcus@yahoo.com>, Isaiah Harden <tritonefanaticism@gmail.com>


Hi Everyone,

Thanks again for being a part of this photo and video session on Sunday
September 13th from 2:00 to 8:30 PM.  I know some people will be leaving
early, this is why I am asking everyone to please be on time.  Here are the
details....

*WHAT TO BRING*
- Your instrument and cables.  You are welcome to bring an amp, but we will
have our mixer there with a PA to record everything, so DI works too.
Kaipo and/or Marcus can you bring a mic for your horn with a stand?  Thanks.
- Music stand, iPad, sheet music, etc.
- 2 outfits.  One is casual/cool.  One is formal.
- Snacks or water if necessary.

*SCHEDULE*
- Photography is first.  Everyone will get their personal photos taken.
Each group (Dante's Inferno and LA Limes) will get group photos.
- Live Performance Videos are second (see detailed schedule/songs below)
- Interview Videos are third.  (Four videos: Sophia Morrow, The Dante's
Inferno, LA Limes, and Isaiah later when he arrives)

*LIVE PERFORMANCE VIDEOS SCHEDULE*
***Please wear your formal outfits for these videos***

*LINK TO CHARTS + AUDIO *(Please let me know if any charts are missing or
incorrect)
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rxIOPSBIPWBXWtY1g7NQ6bNVyBl_vNYa?usp=drive_link

*FULL VOCAL BAND* (Everyone!)
- "Signed, Sealed, Delivered" Stevie Wonder (KEY CHANGE CONCERT Eb MAJ)
- "Let's Stay Together" Al Green (KEY CHANGE CONCERT A MAJ)
- "If I Ain't Got You" Alicia Keys (KEY CHANGE CONCERT Gb/F#)
- "What You Mean to Me" Sophia Morrow

*FULL JAZZ BAND *(Everyone except for Sophia)
- "Blue Train" John Coltrane
- "Meanwhile" LA Limes

*QUARTET JAZZ BAND *(The Dante's Inferno)
- "Song of Choice" Jazz Standard
- "Song of Choice" The Dante's Inferno

*DUETS *(Sophia, Louie, Adrian)
- "If I Ain't Got You" Alicia Keys (KEY CHANGE CONCERT Gb/F#) (Sophia &
Louie Duet)
- "Valerie" Amy Winehouse (Sophia & Adrian Duet)

*INTERVIEW VIDEOS*
- LA Limes first
- The Dante's Inferno second
- Sophia Morrow third

By this time it should be about 6:30 PM.  I know some people have to leave
which is fine!  Everyone should be done and able to leave, except for
myself, Dante, and Benji.  Isaiah arrives around 7 PM.  I am asking Dante
and Benji if they can stay until 8:00/8:30 PM just to record one original
song with Isaiah.

*JAZZ TRIO *(Isaiah, Benji, Dante)
- "Travel" Isaiah Harden

At this point, Dante and Benji can leave.  Torreé and I will stay to film
Isaiah's Video Interview and Photos.

*FOR THE VIDEO INTERVIEWS*
- Answer questions such as how did this band/project get started?  Who are
your influences?  What is your message/intention with the music?  Any
interesting facts, stories.  These will be short, hopefully edited down to
5 or 10 minutes.

Please let me know if you have any questions!  Dante and I will be going to
the studio to grab drums, mics, stands, mixer, etc. before the session.
Reach out to me if you need something from our music studio.

I will give you all the address/parking information for the photo studio
location soon.  I am still waiting to hear from Torreé which studio will be
available.  It will be in DTLA.

Thanks again for contributing to this Record Label!  These videos will help
to create our website, youtube channel, and purs

packet and W-9 over right away so we can start the process.

Thanks so much for your time,

subject: Biz Checklist
body:
VERMONT AVENUE RECORDS

John's Checklist

Only you can do these. They need your name, phone, photos, or logins.
Torreé handles the website, admin, domain settings, and all tech.

1. Google Business Profile (do this first)


1. Go to business.google.com on a laptop.

2. Sign in with your Google account.

3. Click Add your business and type Vermont Avenue Records.

4. Fill in:

- Category: Rehearsal studio or Live music venue
- Address: the rehearsal space
- Phone: your business number
- Website: https://vermontavenuerecords.com
- Hours: when people can reach you

5. Add 5 to 10 real photos of the space.

6. Verify it. Choose video verification if offered, otherwise watch for a
postcard with a code.
Your listing is not public until it is verified.


2. Get Google Reviews

1. In your profile, click Ask for reviews. Copy the link.

2. Save it in your phone as "VA Reviews".

3. Text it the same day after a good session:

Hey, it's John from Vermont Avenue Records. Thanks for coming through. If
you had a good time, mind leaving a quick Google review? It helps us get
found. link

Ask every band, artist, and jam attendee.


3. Claim Apple and Bing

- Apple Maps: businessconnect.apple.com
- Bing Places: bingplaces.com (click "import from Google")
Use the exact same name, address, and phone on both.


4. Your Domain

Your site is vermontavenuerecords.com.

1. Go to whois.com and look it up.
2. Log in to the company you bought it from.
3. Turn on auto renew.
4. Save the login.
If you do not have the login, tell Torreé.
5. One Contact Email
Set up john@vermontavenuerecords.com or similar.
Put it on Google, Instagram, Facebook, Bandcamp, YouTube, and the website.


6. Match Your Socials
Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Bandcamp, Spotify.
Same logo, same description, same website link, same email.

Use this line everywhere:
Vermont Avenue Records is an independent record label and live music
collective in Los Angeles. Created by musicians, for musicians.


If That Is Too Much

Do only these four:
1. Create and verify the Google Business Profile.
2. Get ten Google reviews.
3. Confirm the domain.
4. Set up one contact email.
That puts you ahead of most small labels.
